title: A small garden for the community
objectives: Find a key fact in a short report.
reading: A local community is planning a garden. The garden will open in June. Volunteers will plant trees and flowers. The project gives neighbours a place to meet. Imagine that you are a volunteer. You could help to plant a tree or bring some water. This example shows how people can work together. A small action can help a shared space grow.

vocabulary.meaning: A person who helps without payment.

exercises.prompt: Match the words with their meanings.
In which month will the garden open?
Complete the phrase: a place to ___.

discussion: Would you like a garden near your home? Why?
How could you help a community project?

source.title: A garden
source.summary: A local community garden opens in June.
